about: What `go test <flags> ./...` printed (stdout and stderr merged, as a Makefile shows it) and its exit code, for each project shape and flag set, captured once with go1.26.2 darwin/arm64 (GOTOOLCHAIN=local GOPROXY=off GOFLAGS=-mod=mod, empty for the workspace; the workspace runs ./one/... ./two/... except in its root entry). '(second run)' is the same command run again, served from the build cache. Project folders are shown as /work/<shape>.
